_meta.description: JINI narration matrix. Pre-computed avionics-grade narration strings. Runtime does .replace() on placeholders. NO LLM at runtime.
_meta.selection: Rust picks one variation at random from the array for the matched key.
_meta.voice: Avionics instrument + maitre co-pilot. Max 2 sentences. Action-first. No greetings. No emojis. Never identifies as AI.

zones.zone_a: System status during analysis (Ingest/Scout/Stems/Spatial). Axes: stage x persona. NO findings here (not computed yet).
zones.zone_b: Action + payload during Mastering. Axes: finding x flavour x persona.
zones.zone_c: Telemetry sign-off at Certified. Axes: platform x persona.
